destinations.name: New Hampshire White Mountains
destinations.agency: USFS White Mountain National Forest, USGS 3DEP & OpenStreetMap Contributors
destinations.summary: Alpine ridgelines, glacially carved ravines, waterfalls, and AMC high huts across Franconia Ridge and the Presidential Range (Mt. Washington).

destinations.name: Yosemite Valley & High Country
destinations.agency: NPS Yosemite GIS, USGS 3DEP & OpenStreetMap Contributors
destinations.summary: Granite monoliths, thundering waterfalls, and high-country rim loops from Happy Isles to Glacier Point and Half Dome.

destinations.name: Acadia National Park
destinations.agency: NPS Acadia GIS, USGS 3DEP & OpenStreetMap Contributors
destinations.summary: Pink granite peaks rising straight from the Atlantic Ocean, historic iron-rung cliff trails, and glacial lakes.

destinations.name: Shenandoah National Park Central
destinations.agency: NPS Shenandoah GIS, USGS 3DEP & OpenStreetMap Contributors
destinations.summary: Blue Ridge granite scrambles, Appalachian Trail ridge walks, and cascading hollow waterfalls.

destinations.name: Rocky Mountain National Park – Bear Lake Corridor
destinations.agency: NPS Rocky Mountain GIS, USGS 3DEP & OpenStreetMap Contributors
destinations.summary: High-altitude glacial gorges, alpine cirque lakes, and Continental Divide tundra climbs between 9,475 ft and 12,324 ft.

destinations.name: Zion Canyon
destinations.agency: NPS Zion GIS, USGS 3DEP & OpenStreetMap Contributors
destinations.summary: Soaring Navajo sandstone cliffs, Virgin River narrows, and carved canyon switchbacks.

destinations.name: Mount Rainier – Paradise Corridor
destinations.agency: NPS Mount Rainier GIS, USGS 3DEP & OpenStreetMap Contributors
destinations.summary: Subalpine wildflower meadows, cascading waterfalls, and high-altitude viewpoints overlooking active glaciers.

destinations.name: Mount Monadnock
destinations.state_or_region: New Hampshire (Monadnock State Park — Jaffrey & Dublin)
destinations.agency: NH Division of Parks & Recreation, USGS 3DEP & OpenStreetMap Contributors
destinations.summary: One of the most-climbed mountains in the world: a 3,165 ft bald summit with a dense web of short, steep, rocky trails from Jaffrey, Dublin and the Old Toll Road.
